opinions.text:
Per Curiam: Mr. Chauncey F.' Trarrvutolo for appellant. Messrs. Herman Phleger, Ira H. Rowell, Maurice E. Harrison, and James S. Moore, Jr., for appellees.

The motion of the appellees to dismiss the appeal herein is granted, and the appeal is dismissed for the want of a substantial federal question, Aetna Insurance Co. v. Hyde, 275 U. S. 440, 447; Puget Sound Co. v. Seattle, 291 U. S. 619, 625-626; Public Service Comm’n v. Utilities Co., 289 U. S. 130, 134.
